speaker: caller
text: Hi, this is Apple Support. You received an alert about a sign-in to your Apple ID from a new device.

speaker: receiver
text: Yes, I just got that message. It wasn't me.

speaker: caller
text: Someone is trying to log in right now and they can reach your crypto exchange app through your iCloud.

speaker: receiver
text: Oh no, I have some Bitcoin on that app.

speaker: caller
text: Don't worry, I will help you secure it. Please open the exchange app while I stay on the line.

speaker: caller
text: We need to act fast before they get in, every minute counts.

speaker: receiver
text: What do I need to do?

speaker: caller
text: Transfer all your coins to the Apple secure wallet address I'm sending you, then read me the six-digit code you receive.

speaker: receiver
text: Why does Apple need my coins?

speaker: caller
text: It's only temporary. Once the hacker is blocked, we send everything back to you.

speaker: receiver
text: I think I will check with Apple myself first.
